newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Danae spending A$5 mln in Greek gold hunt.
newsitem.headline: Danae spending A$5 mln in Greek gold hunt.

text.p: Danae Resources Ltd said on Thursday it and joint venture partner Greenwich Resources PLC will spend about A$5 million exploring for gold in northeastern Greece.

Danae, listed on the Australian Stock Exchange, has a 51 percent stake in the Sappes gold mining project near Alexandroupolis on the Agean Sea. Greenwich, based in the United Kingdom, holds the remaining 49 percent.
Danae managing director Peter Prentice said initial production from the mine would be around 52,000 ounces a year over a seven-year mine life at a cash cost of US$208 an ounce.
"We're also looking at the potential to increase that figure," Prentice said.
He said the go-ahead for the mine would be given once a resource base of 400,000 ounces has been established through exploration work.
Inferred resources at the two main prospects at Sappes, Viper and St Demetrios, currently total a combined 204,600 ounces, Prentice told a press briefing.
